run_worker_loop: run the HuggingFace datasets worker loop that processes jobs from a MongoDB queue
create_app_config: create an AppConfig instance loaded from environment variables for the worker
build_job_runner_factory: build a JobRunnerFactory with app config, cache directories, and storage client
test_mongo_connections: test that both cache and queue MongoDB connections are available before starting the worker
init_storage_resources: init parquet metadata directory, statistics cache directory, and storage client for the worker
